name: ddd
description: Eric Evans' Domain-Driven Design as a Claude Code toolkit: skills, subagents and output styles for ubiquitous language, bounded contexts, context maps, aggregates, supple design and core-domain focus.

inject_rules.title: Inject the compact rules at session start
inject_rules.description: Adds the short Domain-Driven Design rule set to every session as always-on context. Leave off when you use several book plugins; the skills load the rules on demand.
